articles.title: Crypto researchers cut Bitcoin and Ethereum quantum attack estimate by 50%
articles.snippet: A paper shared with CoinDesk shows humans and AI agents beating Google’s March result on a core calculation used by Shor’s algorithm, adding another variable to crypto’s quantum clock.

articles.title: Banks Have Minutes, Not Weeks, to Fix Flaws as AI Speeds Up Attacks: BIS
articles.snippet: The Bank for International Settlements says routine patching schedules are increasingly inadequate and cites guidance urging banks to accept planned downtime for urgent fixes.

articles.title: Anthropic Discloses Fourth Claude Hacking Incident as Debate Around Regulation Grows
articles.snippet: The company now says attacks during security tests exposed model behavior failures, after initially emphasizing errors in its testing infrastructure.

articles.title: Cronos Erased Two Hours of Transactions to Reverse $111 Million DeFi Exploit
articles.snippet: The rollback reversed legitimate activity alongside the attack, while $9.19 million remains unrecovered, according to Cronos.
